description: This file defines data structures and methods for generating and representing differences (diffs) between versions of blocks in a project, including properties, schemas, and content blocks, primarily used for notifications in a Mattermost/Focalboard context.

classes.name: Diff
classes.description: Represents differences between two versions of a block, including metadata, authors, and child diffs.

classes.name: PropDiff
classes.description: Represents a change in a property, including old and new values.

classes.name: SchemaDiff
classes.description: Represents a difference between old and new property definitions within a board.

classes.name: diffGenerator
classes.description: A struct responsible for generating diffs between block versions, utilizing store API, logger, and context.

methods.name: generateDiffs
methods.description: Generates diffs for a block, handling different block types and fetching historical versions.

methods.name: generateDiffsForCard
methods.description: Generates diffs for a card and its child blocks.

methods.name: generateDiffForBlock
methods.description: Generates a diff for a specific block, comparing current and historical versions.

methods.name: generatePropDiffs
methods.description: Compares properties of old and new blocks to identify changes.

methods.name: sortPropDiffs
methods.description: Sorts property diffs by their index.
